name: Creation
overview: Scripture reveals that creation is the intentional and sovereign work of God, who in the beginning formed the heavens and the earth. As described in Genesis 1, God brought light into existence by His command, separating it from darkness, and established the cycles of day and night. He continued His creative work by dividing the waters and forming the firmament, demonstrating His purposeful design and authority over all things. This foundational act of creation is both the origin of all that exists and a testament to God's power and goodness.
